summary.name: Allowly Hiring Evidence
summary.one_liner: A hiring-screening evidence tool that evaluates selected structured candidate fields against a frozen, approved policy version and exports signed Hiring Decision Packs.
use_cases: Apply an approved screening policy to structured candidate fields at a hiring stage
Keep a record of screening decisions with policy version and human review
Export a portable, signed decision pack for audit or review
Verify signed screening receipts outside the Hiring UI
Track corrections and repeat screenings without overwriting prior results
summary.what_it_does: Hiring Evidence lets teams define job stages and assign an approved, published policy version to each stage before screening. It receives an opaque candidate ID plus selected structured fields and evaluates them with a deterministic policy runner that uses no language model, returning advance, confirm, escalate, or deny. Confirm and escalate results route to customer-owned review, and reviews or corrections are linked as lineage rather than overwriting earlier results. Each decision is stored with a signed receipt, and Hiring Decision Packs bundle policies, approvals, receipts, reviews, verification keys and file hashes. Candidate files and identity data stay in the customer's own systems.
notable: Deterministic policy runner with no language model: same record and policy version give the same result
Immutable published policy versions with approval records, and corrections stored as linked replacement lineage
Signed receipts and Hiring Decision Packs that can be verified outside the UI
Included with Allowly core plans using the shared account, active-item pool and decision allowance
caveats: Signature checks only show the receipt was signed by the matching Allowly workspace key and is unchanged; they do not prove source truth, policy fairness or legality
Allowly signs its own screening result and is not an independent third-party witness to a separate ATS decision
On the Free plan, the single shared active slot can hold only one Hiring job, agent, or workflow at a time
